summary: Homepage UI smoke and responsive checks passed, but all externally hosted agency/client assets return 403 and one agency lacks an Explore link.

ui_bugs.issue: All 36 referenced images from customer-assets host fail to load (HTTP 403), leaving agency cards and client grid without their intended visuals.
The eighth card has no Explore link because its configured link is null; requirement expects Explore destinations for all agency cards.

action_items: Bundle or serve the accessible reference assets from a working public/static location and verify nonzero naturalWidth for every image.
Add a valid external Explore destination for Metafrom or explicitly revise the requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: The asset base URL is hard-coded to a host returning 403 in the preview, making the primary visual clone incomplete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage, menu open/close, purpose next/previous, contact navigation, mailto links, eight card DOM presence, and desktop/mobile overflow were tested. Recheck image loading and all agency Explore links after fixes.
rca of the issue: App.js constructs every image URL from the customer-assets host. Direct request to Fox_Final.svg returned HTTP 403 application/xml, and browser naturalWidth was zero for all agency/client images. Metafrom is intentionally configured with link: null, so no Explore anchor is rendered.
